description:
lib/map.fz specs Map.put (and the put/delete/update externs and others) as returning any, where Elixir's return map. An any return makes every later protocol dispatch on the result reach every implementation, Stream included (the fz-sc8.117 small case). Tighten each Map function's spec to Elixir's return type and report any pin that moves. Lands after fz-sc8.117, which fixes the termination fault itself.

Includes Map.new/1 and Map.new/2 (lib/map.fz:38 and :51, both specced :: any). fz-8c showed (patch /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/sc8-spec-only.patch, two lines, on the stack tip) that changing those two to :: map cures fz-sc8.119 items 1 and 2 with or without the GH #302 remedy; reduced form: Enum.to_list(File.stream!(path)) next to Enum.reduce(Map.new(["a"], fn l -> {l, 1} end), 0, ...). Acceptance adds: fz-sc8.119's repros (q1/s3 shapes, m2.fz, d2.fz in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/) pass on all three paths against elixir.
title: Map's functions say they return maps
